title: Studio Interfaces rail hides a default/create form that a form action opens by name (rail half of #36545)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

Filing gate: ① owed follow-up of PR #36793 (`Part of #36545`); the Studio rail half of #36545, split out by seat ruling (repo:objectstack#7, 2026-11-24 00:19Z: channel B). Source: fleet.
Blocked-by: #36793

## Defect
After #36793, `os validate` no longer reports a default/create form whose served name exactly equals a `type: 'form'` action's literal target, because `ActionRunner.executeForm` opens it at `/forms/NAME` → FormPage `/meta/view/NAME`. The Studio Interfaces rail still hides that form: `offNavViewIsInternalForm` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.tsx`, fed by `isInternalFormItem` in `packageSurfaces.ts`) sees only page/dashboard/report/view rows and reads no actions, so it treats every non-public `form` / `formViews.default` / `formViews.create` as internal.
reach: named real producer — `examples/app-showcase` `showcase_task` form, opened by a registered form action; the rail leaves it off while the form is reachable at runtime (read at the filter site, not run in a browser).

## Ruled route (B)
Add `client.list('action', { packageId })` (and the pair the packageItems effect already reads) to the StudioDesignSurface packageItems effect, and exempt a view row whose served name equals a `type: 'form'` action's literal target — the same test as the lint rule in #36793. `action` is a sanctioned served list (`protocol-meta-list-reads` serves `request.type: 'action'`): no contract change. Not C (a server-stamped key on served view rows is a contract change the card does not justify).
The remaining gap — inline page actions (`properties.action` on a page component) and actions in other packages — gets a code comment at the filter site and a line in the PR's Acceptance notes, not a new channel.

## Acceptance
- A pin beside `InterfacesNavRail.internalFormHidden-36425.test.ts`: a non-public default form named by a registered form action is listed; a non-public default form nobody opens is still hidden; a public one is listed.
- The `packageSurfaces.ts` comment #36793 left (it names this gap) is replaced by what the code now does.

## Business reason
An author who opens a form from an action cannot find that form in Studio's Interfaces rail to edit it, while `os validate` says it is fine; the two surfaces disagree.

Hands-on reader: o7-studio (seat repo:objectstack#7 puts it in that area's row).
Dedupe: open+closed issues for `offNavViewIsInternalForm` (1 hit, #36545), `form-view-internal-not-loaded rail` (3: #36545, #36425 closed, #6015 seat post).

Suggested-grade: p2 · a reachable form hidden in the authoring rail · suggested domain `domain:ui` · area:build · for triage first touch.
